event_rule: Recorded order, nondecreasing timestamp, different IDs allowed at equal time; no sorting/deduplication; duplicate same-time ID rejected; handoff command and ACK must each be unique and ordered
sampled_topics: Unchanged strict timestamp and continuity checks
coordinate_rule: One exact binary64 compiled-receiver representation, pinned source/compiler/compile command; no epsilon or ULP band
source_record: Original integer encoding, projection and provenance remain unchanged; receiver expectation is a separate derived record
other_thresholds: Unchanged protocol06 numerical, safety, lifecycle, reference and downstream coverage checks
acceptance: Offline revised_checks_passed only; accepted remains false even when checks pass
next_flight: Requires separately frozen and authorized protocol; this directory provides no flight runner
